import sys, urllib.request, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

sources = [
    ("VentureBeat AI", "https://venturebeat.com/category/ai/feed/"),
    ("TechCrunch AI", "https://techcrunch.com/category/artificial-intelligence/feed/"),
    ("AI News", "https://www.artificialintelligence-news.com/feed/"),
    ("AI Weekly", "https://aiweekly.co/issues.rss"),
]

all_items = []

for name, url in sources:
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as r:
            data = r.read()
        root = ET.fromstring(data)
        channel = root.find("channel")
        items = channel.findall("item") if channel else root.findall(".//item")
        for item in items[:4]:
            title = item.findtext("title", "").strip()
            desc  = item.findtext("description", "").strip()[:250]
            date  = item.findtext("pubDate", item.findtext("published", "")).strip()
            link  = item.findtext("link", "").strip()
            if title:
                all_items.append((name, title, desc, date, link))
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[{name}] ERROR: {e}")

print(f"\nTotal items fetched: {len(all_items)}\n")
for src, title, desc, date, link in all_items:
    print(f"SOURCE : {src}")
    print(f"TITLE  : {title}")
    print(f"DATE   : {date}")
    print(f"DESC   : {desc}")
    print(f"LINK   : {link}")
    print("-" * 80)
EOF
